## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready ADAS-Cog total records, summarizes baseline, Week 24, and change from baseline by treatment, and applies the efficacy model used for treatment comparisons.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: analysis parameter code, restricted to ACTOT
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `BASE`: baseline value
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: population and analysis-record flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
